result.summary: The page is generally well-structured, but one obvious content/localization defect is visible, along with minor horizontal overflow and viewport occlusion issues.

issues.description: The section heading displays the raw translation key "home_feed.popular_title" instead of a user-facing title.
issues.suggestion: Resolve the localization key and display the intended translated heading, such as "Popular near you" or the appropriate localized equivalent.

issues.description: Several horizontally scrolling elements are visibly clipped at the right edge, including the category chips and the third restaurant card title/image.
issues.suggestion: Ensure the horizontal carousel is intentionally scrollable with appropriate padding and affordance, and verify that clipped content does not appear accidentally cut off.

issues.description: The fixed bottom navigation overlaps the lower restaurant card, leaving its content visibly cut off in the viewport.
issues.suggestion: Add sufficient bottom padding to the scrollable page content so cards can be scrolled fully above the navigation bar.
